sources.title: GitHub - inclusionAI/Ling: Ling is a MoE LLM provided and open-sourced ...
sources.snippet: Ling is a MoE LLM provided and open-sourced by InclusionAI. We introduce two different sizes, which are Ling-lite and Ling-plus. Ling-lite has 16.8 billion parameters with 2.75 billion activated parameters, while Ling-plus has 290 billion parameters with 28.8 billion activated parameters. Both models demonstrate impressive performance compared to existing models in the industry.
